mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate component of the equity discount rate, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (UNRATE > 6.0 and monthly rise > 0.2), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based deterioration in consumer demand, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery phase, a monthly increase in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals strengthening supply chain activity and improving corporate earnings prospects, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO monthly change > 0.5% during the post-pandemic recovery, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening residential investment and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which triggers expectations of monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% during a monetary tightening cycle, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
